data.narrative:
Ulysses Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Akhil Voorakkara, Jamie Wedderburn, Colm O'Brien, and Will O'Brien, having raised $38M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, including same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies such as Generalist AI ($2.0B, Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), and Walden Robotics ($1.1B, Seed).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement, implying $76M. Peer-median analysis across the four comparables yields a median valuation of $1.7B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. The substantial gap between methods reflects stage disparity within the peer set—three comparables are at Series B versus Ulysses' Series A positioning.

The triangulated valuation range is $65M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $888M. The wide spread reflects meaningful uncertainty around appropriate stage discount relative to Series B peers and whether peer valuations represent achievable market multiples for earlier-stage companies in this sector. Stage-adjusted valuation more conservatively suggests $200M–$400M before full reconciliation to peer benchmarks.
